heroDescription: Nord generates income from environmental cleanup. Tailings processing removes century-old deposits. Underground backfill stabilizes workings. Every tonne processed improves the site while recovering metals.
heroList1: 411 g/t silver equivalent in Miller Creek tailings
heroList3: Cemented backfill at $17-30/m³ within metal value
quote: We're demonstrating that environmental remediation can be profitable. The metals we recover from tailings more than pay for the cleanup. This model could transform how the industry approaches legacy sites globally.
rehabilitationDescription: Before any regulatory requirement, Nord began addressing hazards at the historic Castle Mine. Open shafts posed risks to workers and recreational users. We systematically secured the site.
environment1Description: Sonic drilling confirmed high silver grades in historic tailings. Miller Creek samples range from 49-370 g/t silver with average 282 g/t in calculated heads. Beaver tailings grade up to 314 g/t. Our gravity circuits recover silver that century-old stamp mills missed.
environment2Description: TTL supports advanced hydrometallurgical programs for concentrates that conventional smelters reject. Operating at atmospheric pressure with significantly less energy than pyrometallurgy, these processes convert penalty elements to stable forms while recovering valuable metals.
environment2List3: Recovers battery-grade metals from complex waste streams
